page.overview:
Who is Beris?

Beris was a veteran of the Jihad. He presumably lived in the suburb of Arrakeen built for veterans of the Jihad. In this suburb was a chalk pronouncement, Beris was accused of bringing a "loathsome disease" back to Arrakis which had deprived him of his manhood.
